checked_claims.note: Reconstructed independently and it holds, but it is weaker than it presents itself. Arithmetic ledger rechecked from scratch: 2*21-16=26; for X smooth of dimension 21, H^{BM}_{16}(X;Q)=H^{26}(X;Q)(21) and 26-2*21=-16, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} is the lowest-weight step, equals Gr^W_{-16}, and is pure; Q(-13) has weight 26 and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8) of weight -16, so (a)<=>(b) is exact. (c): H^{BM}_k is the Q-dual of H^k_c with no twist, dualising reverses the filtration so Gr^W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} is dual to Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c, and Q(-8)^vee=Q(8); exact. (d): in H^{15}(D)->H^{16}_c(M)->H^{16}(Mbar)->H^{16}(D) with Mbar_{6,6} smooth proper and D proper (possibly singular), H^{15}(D) has weights at most 15, so W_{15}H^{16}_c = im(H^{15}(D)) and Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c = ker(H^{16}(Mbar)->H^{16}(D)) = K; exact, and (a) is verbatim the packet's exact theorem at L6. The semisimplicity step is valid and in fact needs less than polarizability: a sub-Q-Hodge-structure of a structure of pure type (-8,-8) is again of pure type (-8,-8), hence Q(8)^s. Non-adverse but material: the whole content of this claim is the packet-adjudicated FND-0033 ('any subquotient of a direct sum of Tate objects in that row is again a direct sum of the same Tate object') applied to the FND-0180 datum, so the claim is correct but not new, and its hypothesis is the campaign target itself.

Correct as stated. T_Z is a subobject of T, so every subquotient of T_Z is a subquotient of T; if T were Q(8)^r all its subquotients would be Q(8)^s. Hence a non-Tate subquotient of T_Z refutes RED-0001. This is the sound half of the weld. Recorded caveat, adverse only where CLM-0122-5 and novelty_claims push it further: the claim as written does not assert the converse necessity, and the converse is false (see CLM-0122-5).

The stated conclusion dim Y <= 17 is compatible with the packet, but the proof offered is the exact derivation an adjudicated finding records as invalid. ATT-0122 Section 3 argues: 'Y is equally obtained from an etale atlas of Hbar^bal ... Over such an atlas the ordered reduced-support incidence is finite etale over the reduced-support open of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle, hence of pure dimension dim(Hbar^bal)+2 = 15+2 = 17 (dependency claims CLM-0112-6/7 and CLM-0112-8)'. FND-0187 states precisely that ATT-0112/CLM-0112-8 'is established over smooth finite-type scheme atlases of the fixed-target stack H^bal and does not transfer verbatim to a general etale scheme atlas S of Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2]'. Independently reconstructed, the defect is real: CLM-0112-8 supplies relative dimension two over an atlas of H^bal (dimension 18, giving the 18+2=20 model of FND-0180/FND-0181), and the descent of pi_*L and its P^2-bundle to the quotient is a separate PGL_2-equivariance statement (FND-0184: 'a morphism [H/G]->X ... requires a separate G-equivariance/G-invariance hypothesis'), not a consequence of CLM-0112-6/7. The generic principle the attempt invokes, 'a finite-type morphism cannot increase dimension of the image', is also not available in the quotient-stack form used: dim[W/PGL_2] = dim W - 3 holds for any quotient stack irrespective of stabilizer dimension, so the recorded value 15 for Hbar^bal carries no finite-stabilizer content by itself and does not license the image bound without the DM property. FND-0187 records the available repair (PGL_2-invariance of the classifying morphism via CLM-0112-7, so the dimension-20 H^bal-level model factors through a stack quotient of dimension 20-3=17); ATT-0122 gestures at 'exploiting the confirmed PGL_2-invariance' but does not carry the repair out, and it does not declare ATT-0112 or CLM-0112-6/7/8 among its dependencies. Unresolved rather than failed because FND-0186 records that dim Y <= 17 does hold once the FND-0187 repair is included.

Verified independently. In the Borel-Moore localization sequence H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->H^{BM}_{16}(X)->H^{BM}_{16}(U_Y), exactness gives ker = im, and strictness of morphisms of mixed Hodge structures for W gives f(W_{-16}A) = f(A) cap W_{-16}B, so W_{-16}im = im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->T) = ker(r_T) = T_Z. The cohomological form is the same statement under H^{26}_Y(X)(21)=H^{BM}_{16}(Y) on the smooth X. The attempt correctly uses only the image and never the supports group itself, so the FND-0168(3a)/(3b) hazard, which REV-0169 flagged as recurring in the ordinary-cohomology language, is genuinely avoided here. Non-adverse: this restates the packet-adjudicated FND-0180 ('T_Z = im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->T)') rather than adding to it.

Split verdict, adverse on the load-bearing conjunct. The first half is correct and I independently agree with it: the assigned theorem is not discharged, RED-0001 is supplied by no verified artifact, and the forgetful-tower reduction of Section 4.2 terminates in undetermined weight-26 local-system cohomology (GAP-0122-2), which the attempt correctly declines to rename (blocked route forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown respected; FND-0036 is used only inside the Leray isomorphism, not as a resolution route). The second half fails. The claim asserts that 'the only missing input for the proof direction is the Tate property of T', and novelty_claims sharpens this to 'no other route can discharge this subproblem without settling that object'. That is false against the packet the attempt binds to: FND-0185 records 'If W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), then T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8)', a sufficient input for the assigned theorem that says nothing about T and does not settle RED-0001; FND-0186 records a further dimension-threshold vanishing route. RED-0001 and the FND-0185 hypothesis are logically incomparable, so sufficiency of RED-0001 does not confer necessity. The attempt's own Section 6 items (ii) and (iii) contradict its uniqueness assertion as well.

Contract check under this cell's target-interface artifact contract, and the reason the artifact does not clear its own theorem. Field population is compliant: target_interface_reference is present, interface_claim_ids is a nonempty list (CLM-0120-1..7), and interface_attempt_id, target_subquotient, target_map_use and survival_or_tate_argument are all nonempty. The named objects are also correct and not surrogates: interface_attempt_id ATT-0120 is the verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum dual-confirmed by REV-0169 and REV-0170; target_subquotient is the genuine ker(r_T) inside T with the correct degree/weight/twist and the correct image form; target_map_use is the ATT-0120 kernel inclusion used as an embedding into a pure object, not smuggled in as a Gysin map. The contract nevertheless fails on its substantive test. survival_or_tate_argument is explicitly labelled 'Tate argument (conditional...)' and concludes the Tate property of T_Z only under a hypothesis the same field lists as an open gap (GAP-0122-1). A conditional whose antecedent is undischarged does not prove the stated theorem, so the named source, map and subquotient, though correct, do not deliver the coverage the contract requires. Binding check, separately, is clean: packet_id, packet_sha256 23efe9f2..., packet_binding_sha256 2054a3c3..., campaign_revision 5, context_revision 2, task_id TASK-C66-M-005, subproblem_id C66-TATE-SUPPORT, all thirteen entries of the target dictionary, and the theorem_statement string all match TASK.json exactly.

finding_candidates.rationale: Reusable screening rule for future C66-TATE-SUPPORT submissions, which are structurally tempted toward the RED-0001 conditional because it is one line from FND-0033. FND-0185 records its own sufficiency and marks it 'not necessary', but does not adjudicate the non-necessity of RED-0001 or rule the RED-0001 conditional out of the lane; FND-0168(2) records circularity for a different object (the K-versus-Hodge-classes equivalence). Directly falsifies ATT-0122/CLM-0122-5 and its second novelty claim.
finding_candidates.statement: For C66-TATE-SUPPORT at (g,n)=(6,6), the hypothesis RED-0001 ('T = W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8)') is sufficient for the Tate type of the interface subquotient T_Z, because T_Z is a subobject of T and FND-0033 applies, but it is not necessary, and no artifact may assert that discharging C66-TATE-SUPPORT requires settling RED-0001. Two adjudicated inputs already discharge the subproblem without touching RED-0001: FND-0185 (Tate-ness of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) implies Tate-ness of T_Z, through the FND-0180 image form T_Z = im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->T)) and FND-0186 (dimension-threshold vanishing of the Y'-supported contribution). The FND-0185 hypothesis concerns a closed support of dimension at most 17 and is logically incomparable with RED-0001, so sufficiency in one direction confers no necessity in the other. Only the contrapositive is valid: a non-Tate subquotient of T_Z refutes RED-0001. Consequently a conditional whose antecedent is RED-0001 is campaign-circular and cannot satisfy a weakest-sufficient-proof lane for this subproblem, since a weaker and non-circular sufficient input is already adjudicated.

finding_candidates.rationale: Reusable adjudication rule for every cell carrying this contract. The failure mode is distinct from the surrogate-substitution failure the contract was written to catch, and is invisible to a schema-level check, so it needs to be recorded before a syntactically complete conditional clears a gate.
finding_candidates.statement: Under the target-interface artifact contract, the required object target_interface_reference can be fully populated - nonempty interface_attempt_id, nonempty interface_claim_ids, correctly named target_subquotient and target_map_use, and a nonempty survival_or_tate_argument - by an artifact whose Tate argument concludes only under an antecedent the same field lists as an open gap. Field population is therefore not evidence of contract compliance. The substantive test must be applied to the modality of the argument's conclusion: the named source, map and subquotient must yield the stated theorem unconditionally, and a survival_or_tate_argument that is self-labelled conditional, or whose text names a gap marker as its missing hypothesis, fails the contract even when every named object is correct and no surrogate has been substituted. ATT-0122 is the witness: its source, map and subquotient are all the genuine ATT-0120 objects and no surrogate cohomology result is offered, yet the contract is not met.

finding_candidates.rationale: Evidence for an existing adjudicated finding rather than a new one: it shows the non-transfer is a recurring downstream failure mode and identifies the two auxiliary gaps that make it easy to miss, so reviewers can screen for the quotient-stack image-dimension step directly.
finding_candidates.statement: Further instance of the FND-0187 non-transfer, now in a downstream artifact that presents it as a novel sharpening rather than as a repair. ATT-0122/CLM-0122-3 derives dim Y <= 17 by transporting ATT-0112/CLM-0112-8's relative-dimension-two reduced-support incidence to an etale atlas of Hbar^bal = [H^bal/PGL_2] and computing 15+2, which is exactly the transfer FND-0187 records as invalid, and it cites only CLM-0112-6/7 and CLM-0112-8 in support. Two further defects are visible in this instance and are worth recording alongside the finding. First, the general principle invoked, that a finite-type morphism cannot increase the dimension of its image, is not available in the quotient-stack form used, because dim[W/PGL_2] = dim W - 3 holds for every quotient stack irrespective of stabilizer dimension, so the recorded value dim Hbar^bal = 15 carries no finite-stabilizer content and the image bound needs the Deligne-Mumford property as a separate input. Second, ATT-0112 and CLM-0112-6/7/8 are not declared in the artifact's proof_dependencies or dependency_claim_ids, so the non-transferring step enters through an undeclared transitive citation. The FND-0187 repair route (PGL_2-invariance of the classifying morphism, factoring the dimension-20 H^bal-level model through a stack quotient of dimension 20-3=17) is alluded to but not executed.

proof_dependency_checks.note: Verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum, dual-confirmed by REV-0169 and REV-0170. ATT-0122 uses it strictly within its confirmed claims: CLM-0120-3 for the localization map and the weight/twist ledger, CLM-0120-4 for T_Z = ker(r_T) as a pure weight -16 subobject, CLM-0120-5 for coverage, CLM-0120-6 for atlas independence and the PGL_2 reformulation, CLM-0120-7 for the no-Tate/no-Gysin scope. No claim is used beyond what the two confirmations checked. Non-adverse binding note: ATT-0120, REV-0169 and REV-0170 all record packet_sha256 10948ae9..., while TASK.json and ATT-0122 record 23efe9f2...; packet_binding_sha256 is 2054a3c3... in every one of these artifacts, so the binding is stable across the packet regeneration and the import is sound. Adverse note carried on CLM-0122-3, not here: ATT-0120 Section 8 explicitly disclaims 'Dimension of Y, equidimensionality of Y, or that dim Y = 17', so the dimension sharpening is not licensed by this dependency.

First independent confirmation of ATT-0120 (claude, pass 1). Used as ATT-0122 declares: the polarizability note on CLM-0120-4, the image-form description on CLM-0120-5, the residual-weakness record that the interface transmits no CE-geometric information, and the candidate bound dim Y <= 20. That bound is a review candidate, not an adjudicated finding, and the packet independently records the same bound as FND-0181; ATT-0122's treatment of it as unproved-then-improved is fair.

Second independent confirmation of ATT-0120 (qwen, pass 2). Used for the image-form note on CLM-0120-4, the PGL_2-invariance note on CLM-0120-6, and the no-Tate-assertion note on CLM-0120-7. Recorded but non-adverse: ATT-0122's engine is qwen and REV-0170's reviewer_engine is qwen, so one of the two confirmations it leans on shares its engine; every item ATT-0122 draws from REV-0170 is independently confirmed in REV-0169 by a different engine, so no load-bearing step rests on the shared-engine confirmation alone. REV-0170's own finding candidate 'common-refinement-atlas-descent' states that descent across [H/G] 'additionally requires a separate proof that the X-valued moduli point is G-invariant', which is consistent with the CLM-0122-3 defect recorded above.

Adjudicated Poincare reindexing W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) = W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) at d = 21, applied only on M_{6,6} and never on Y or U_Y, so no codimension shift, Gysin twist or Kunneth shift is engaged. Twist direction rechecked against the task target dictionary: ordinary_weight 26 minus 2*poincare_twist 21 equals open_bm_weight -16, and open_bm_degree 16 equals 2*21 - 26. Q-coefficient stack duality via the rational comparison with the coarse space; integral coefficients and coarse-moduli variants are out of scope and are not used.

Used but not declared. CLM-0122-3 cites CLM-0112-6/7 (Hbar^bal smooth of pure dimension 15) and CLM-0112-8 (relative dimension two of the reduced-support incidence) as its load-bearing inputs, yet ATT-0112 does not appear in ATT-0122's proof_dependencies and no CLM-0112-* identifier appears in its dependency_claim_ids, which list only CLM-0120-1..7. Citing them as 'recorded in ATT-0120 Section 1' does not transfer them, and the transfer is exactly where the claim breaks: CLM-0112-8 is a statement over scheme atlases of H^bal, and FND-0187 records that it does not carry to etale atlases of Hbar^bal, which is the form CLM-0122-3 needs. Unresolved rather than failed because ATT-0112 is itself dual-confirmed (REV-0157, REV-0158) and the needed dimension conclusion is recoverable through the FND-0187 repair, which this artifact does not perform.

The campaign target claim, and the undischarged antecedent of CLM-0122-1: 'W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8)', identical to the packet's exact theorem at L6. The attempt states plainly that no verified artifact supplies it (GAP-0122-1) and attests resolves_exact_target = false. Because the entire Tate conclusion of the submitted theorem_statement passes through this antecedent, this unresolved dependency is the primary ground of the incomplete verdict. It is not a defect of honesty on the attempt's part; it is the reason the artifact does not reach its own stated theorem.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack, and the one that decides the verdict: judge the artifact against the theorem_statement it actually submitted rather than against the lemma it wanted to be judged on. The submitted theorem_statement is the assigned unconditional statement, 'Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8)'. What is proved is Lemma 1, the conditional 'T Tate implies T_Z Tate', whose antecedent is RED-0001, the campaign target itself. Under the target-interface artifact contract this shows up structurally: survival_or_tate_argument is self-labelled '(conditional...)' and its own text names GAP-0122-1 as the missing input, so the required field is populated but concludes nothing unconditional. The attempt does not conceal this - resolves_exact_target is false, status is proposed, Section 0 says up front the theorem is not discharged - and that candour is why the outcome is incomplete rather than refuted. But candour does not convert a conditional into the theorem, and the harness asks for a verdict on the stated theorem. Second attack, aimed at the one place the artifact claims to add something unconditional. CLM-0122-3's derivation of dim Y <= 17 is the exact route FND-0187 records as non-transferring: it transports CLM-0112-8's relative-dimension-two incidence, established over scheme atlases of H^bal, onto an etale atlas of Hbar^bal and computes 15+2. Reconstructed independently, the gap is genuine on two counts. First, descent of pi_*L and its P^2-bundle to [H^bal/PGL_2] is a separate equivariance statement (FND-0184), not a consequence of the cited CLM-0112-6/7. Second, the invoked principle that a finite-type morphism cannot raise the dimension of its image is unavailable in quotient-stack form here, because dim[W/PGL_2] = dim W - 3 holds for every quotient stack regardless of stabilizer dimension, so 'Hbar^bal has dimension 15' carries no finite-stabilizer content and cannot by itself bound the image; the bound needs the DM property, which the cited claims do not supply in the form used. The conclusion survives via the FND-0187 repair (PGL_2-invariance of the classifying morphism, so the dimension-20 H^bal-level model factors through a quotient of dimension 20-3=17), which the artifact gestures at but never carries out, so the claim stands unresolved rather than refuted - and the sharpening is in any case already adjudicated in FND-0186/FND-0187, contrary to the artifact's novelty claim. Third attack, on the weld itself. CLM-0122-5 and novelty_claim 2 assert that RED-0001 is the unique missing input and that no other route can discharge the subproblem. False: FND-0185 records that Tate-ness of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) implies T_Z Tate through the FND-0180 image form, a hypothesis about a 17-dimensional closed support that is logically incomparable with RED-0001 and settles nothing about T; FND-0186 adds a dimension-threshold vanishing route. Only the contrapositive half of the weld (CLM-0122-2) is sound. This matters for the lane: an artifact filed as weakest-sufficient-proof has supplied a sufficient hypothesis that is neither weakest nor non-circular, while a weaker adjudicated one already sits in the packet unengaged. Attacks that were pressed and failed, in the order of the adversary checklist. Degree and twist ledger: 2*21-16=26, 26-42=-16, Q(-13)(21)=Q(8), Borel-Moore dual to compactly supported cohomology in the same degree with no twist and Q(-8)^vee=Q(8), and the proper-pair identity Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c(M_{6,6}) = ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6})->H^{16}(D)) follows because D is proper so H^{15}(D) has weights at most 15; all four equivalences (a)-(d) survive, and (a) is verbatim the packet's exact theorem. Cohomology degree versus Borel-Moore degree is kept separate throughout; 26 and 16 are never interchanged. Poincare duality is applied only on the smooth M_{6,6}, never on Y or U_Y, so no codimension-four Gysin shift and no Kunneth shift is owed, and none is smuggled in. Stack versus coarse moduli and integral versus rational coefficients: everything is Q-coefficient and stack-level, with the coarse comparison used only where it is valid. Spectral-sequence differentials: only a long exact sequence is load-bearing; the Leray tower of Section 4.2 appears strictly inside the gap analysis and is not used to conclude anything, and FND-0036's vanishing is confined to that isomorphism rather than repurposed as a vcd-only resolution. Invariants versus coinvariants: the ordered model maps to the ordered stack, so no S_6 choice arises and FND-0152(ii) is not engaged. Semisimplification versus honest isomorphism: T is pure (FND-0033), T_Z is a genuine sub-Hodge-structure and not a graded piece, and no semisimplification is substituted for an isomorphism. Supports group versus its image: CLM-0122-4 uses only the image, correctly, so the FND-0168(3a)/(3b) hazard that REV-0169 flagged as recurring is genuinely avoided; I verified the strictness step independently. Pure Tate silently upgraded to algebraic or tautological generation: not present, and FND-0168(4)'s Hodge-conjecture trap is not walked. Predicted motives as theorems: none used. Omitted stable pairs: Mbar_{6,6} and its boundary enter only through the duality identity (d), which opens no boundary accounting that could omit a term. Finally, the disproof lane: I attempted a refutation and it does not close. The packet's product-model witnesses FND-0176 and FND-0178 do defeat the revision-4 universal form of C66-TATE-SUPPORT, but the revision-5 theorem under review was narrowed precisely to the named T_Z reached through the verified interface, and those witnesses are the excluded surrogate lanes; no non-Tate subquotient of this T_Z is exhibitable through phi while GAP-0122-3 holds and no source class has proved nonzero image. Hence incomplete, not refuted.
theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
